They are a company-wide benchmark, not a scientifically derived, product-specific, or grade-specific stainless-steel emission factor, and must not be presented or used as one. The per-grade/per-process breakdown elsewhere in this application (emission_factors.json) remains fully DEMO_PLACEHOLDER and is NOT reconciled against this corporate benchmark.
